gen-gf-goldman-gf-chivo: Commanding in tone, Goldman spreads wide round letters across the heading with a tall lowercase. Chivo follows in a plain sans, its curves showing daylight all the way through, so paragraphs stay friendly and approachable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Wide, rounded and unmistakably loud, Goldman fills the top of the page with parenthesis-like curves. It handles attention best; Chocolate Classical Sans, a broad-nibbed sans-serif, handles the reading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, its curves never clogging and its lowercase filling most of the line height. And Goldman, wide and commanding, is the loud half that gives the pairing its punch.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-cossette-texte: Neutral and clean, Cossette Texte gives its lowercase e a wide-eyed look and sets n arches as thick as its stems. And Goldman's round, widely spaced heading letters lead into that body without any fuss.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-duru-sans: Goldman is wide, bold and rounded like open parentheses, set over a modern sans-serif with generous openings on small letters. Duru Sans runs smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fresca: Bold shapes, then tidy ones. Goldman's wide rounded letters take the heading while Fresca, a plain sans with connected counters and short ascenders, quietly carries the text beneath it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-funnel-sans: Wide, round and loud, Goldman towers over a body of Funnel Sans, a plain sans with bars as heavy as its stems. It keeps lines tidy and steady.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and tidy, with short ascenders and wide-eyed e shapes. Goldman is best at making bold, widely set headings; Gafata is best at holding a plain sans line together.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-geist: Professional in manner, Goldman sets wide round heading letters with a big lowercase, each stroke carrying the same visual weight. Geist, a sans-serif with a quiet level beat, makes words read as solid blocks over a long page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-georama: Goldman brings wide, bold, rounded letters to the heading. Georama's open c, like a bracelet pulled apart, and its barely rising capitals give the sans text a relaxed footing under that commanding top.
